title: CS for House Concurrent Resolution No. 3 (Establishing the Joint Legislative Task Force on Artificial Intelligence)
scope: Establishes a Joint Legislative Task Force on Artificial Intelligence to examine the development, implementation, regulation, economic opportunities, workforce implications, and ethical/privacy/legal issues of AI as it relates to Alaska state government operations and statewide AI use.
models_covered: Broadly covers artificial intelligence tools and technologies including expert systems, machine learning models, generative agents, related hardware platforms and software systems, and generated images.
key_requirements: Create a set of common terms and definitions to support task force work and future legislation
Evaluate current and potential applications and costs of AI in state government operations (data management, public service delivery, decision-making, efficiency, staffing)
Assess economic opportunities from AI development including entrepreneurship, data centers, and technology hubs
Investigate ethical, legal, and privacy concerns related to AI use and generated images in public and private sectors
Explore workforce implications and recommend training and education initiatives for AI-related employment
Recommend policies and legislation to ensure responsible and secure AI use inside and outside state government
Develop a long-term strategic plan and recommended budgets to foster AI innovation while safeguarding public interests
Submit a report of findings and recommendations to the legislature by January 31, 2026; task force expires February 2, 2026
